sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def probe(r,c,label):
    before = current_frame.ascii
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    after = current_frame.ascii
    bl=before.split('\n'); al=after.split('\n')
    changed=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if bl[rr][cc]!=al[rr][cc]]
    print(label,'changed',len(changed),'no_impact',res.get('no_impact'))
    if changed:
        r0=min(rr for rr,cc in changed); r1=max(rr for rr,cc in changed)
        c0=min(cc for rr,cc in changed); c1=max(cc for rr,cc in changed)
        print('bbox',r0,r1,c0,c1)
        for rr in range(max(0,r0-1),min(64,r1+2)):
            print(rr, al[rr][max(0,c0-1):c1+2])
    return res, changed

probes=[(38,38,'BR-blue(0,0)'),(10,14,'TL-pattern-W-top'),(63,32,'orange-bar'),(34,32,'gray-frame-top'),(2,2,'black-bg')]
for p in probes:
    res,ch = probe(*p)
    if ch: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
